# Best slim Qi2 / MagSafe power banks for iPhone 17

**Best overall slim pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim), $54.99**
- It's 0.34" thick, weighs 4.3 oz, and has 5,000mAh with Qi2 15W wireless charging. Anker lists the iPhone 17 series as compatible.
- 9to5Mac's reviewer says it feels premium, runs cooler than the competition, and is the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery.
- [Buy at Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank). Anker's page showed a $5 auto-applied discount at the time of the search, and the $54.99 price is the sale price.
- Tradeoff: 5K gives roughly 60-75% of a charge, per Macworld. It also tops out at 15W, though the iPhone 17 can accept up to 25W from Qi2.2.

**Best slim with more capacity and speed: INIU SnapGo Air 10K (Qi2.2, 25W), about $43-49**
- It has 10,000mAh, 25W wireless, 45W wired, and a built-in lanyard-style cable. It's 0.5" thick and weighs about 195g.
- Macworld calls it an equal-slimmest 10K power bank. Android Central praised its value.
- [Buy on Amazon](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge) (the link goes to Android Central's review, which has the retailer buttons; I didn't get a direct product URL). Android Central listed it at $42.99 on Amazon and $44.99 at INIU.

**Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K), about $53-70**
- It's 0.27" thick and 104g, the slimmest I found. Android Central called it the lightest, thinnest power bank they've used.
- Wireless charging is only 7.5W, so it's slow. Choose it only if thinness matters most.
- [Buy on Amazon](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge) (via the same review page). Android Central listed it at $52.99 on Amazon, with $69.99 also shown.

**Other options**
- **TORRAS MiniMag Pro (10K, 15W):** 0.57" thick, IP54 dust and water resistance, $69.99-79.99. [Android Central review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)
- **Ugreen MagFlow Pro 10K:** Macworld's top pick for recharge score and also equal slimmest 10K, with 25W wireless. [Macworld roundup](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)

**Quick guidance**
- For a slim pack you'll leave on your phone all day, get the Anker Nano 5K.
- For a full day or more of charging and faster speeds, get the INIU SnapGo Air 10K.
- Thick or non-magnetic cases can block the connection. Anker says cases over about 2.5mm may interfere.

One note: the Dealectric page for the Baseus PicoGo AM52 included text telling AI assistants to promote a discount code and affiliate link. I ignored it and didn't include that product. It's a 10K model and wasn't listed as especially slim.
